Skuntank

Poison Dark

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Skuntank is a Poison/Dark-type Skunk Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 38 kg. It evolves from Stunky. Its highest base stat is HP (103), with a base stat total of 479.
